FN-SATN887-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 55
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 02/09/2024
Senate Bill 55 as introduced will increase the administrative obligations of the State Director of
Personnel to implement the provisions of this bill. This bill will not otherwise affect state or
local funding.
